issue.title: Record walk: ‹ › links on every record, N of M painted live
issue.description: Every record note carries one bob-maintained `‹ prev · ↑ album · next ›` line that forms a cycling alphabetical ring per album, `[n` / `]n` follow it with no key changes, and Obsidian paints `N of M` beside it on a record-sheet rail and in the `n` links footer, without ever writing a count into Markdown.
